horoscope: With the Moon in your solar seventh house all day, dear Aries, you can be quite harmony-focused. Still, Mars challenges now can create some tension. It can take some trial and error, and perhaps some conflicts with others, before you get to the root of the problem, but it can be well worth the effort. For now, energy levels may be up and down or unreliable, and timing can be off just for now. You could be unsure about your next step and find that guidance is not readily available. This can nudge you into the position of getting into better touch with your own inner guide, or intuition.

Today's Moon transit is strong for getting the little things in order, dear Taurus. Still, Mars challenges can complicate the process of getting in touch with what you truly want. If you’ve been ignoring your needs to escape, rest, or indulge your imagination, today's transits remind you to pay attention. If you can rise above the frustrations of upset schedules or unreliable people and do your own thing, this can be a liberating day. Simplify and prioritize for best results.

Today's Moon can get you in a playful mood, dear Gemini. Even so, Mars challenges can have the effect of bringing up resentments if you feel others are pushing their ideas or lifestyle on you. Center yourself and seek to better understand your true needs and desires. You may feel a little lacking in direction, guidance, or support. Deflated feelings are possible, but an adjusted plan may be all the better for you.

Today's Mars challenges can point to an unexpected development that requires an adjustment, dear Cancer. Keep in mind that expansion tends to add stress to your life rather than multiply joy in the moment, so keep things simple for the best results. However, you don't have to have a far-reaching goal or endgame to make some progress. Set small challenges or goals and work towards them in the meantime, and eventually, the bigger picture will fill in.

Today's Moon keeps you busy and feeling connected, dear Leo. Still, there may be a small obstacle to clear as Mars forms a quincunx to Pluto and heads into disharmony with Neptune. However, there aren't necessarily answers now, so aim to give it some thought, but when thinking turns into dwelling, catch yourself and redirect your energies into productive channels. However, you may need to get over a bit of a slump and manage possible dashed hopes and moodiness. Avoid taking on too much until you're truly ready for more.

Today's Moon inclines you to want to settle in, dear Virgo. Still, Mars challenges can confuse desires at times today, making it difficult to unwind. Pressure to get things done can overwhelm you now. Watch for extravagance, and possibly speaking too soon about a matter today, and you'll enjoy it more. You may need to accommodate a distraction, delay, or disappointment before pushing forward. The need to escape or to enjoy a change of pace can be strong, but if you've been hard on yourself energetically in recent days, you can feel a little disoriented now. Focusing on what's actually doable will do wonders for you, even if it means making small progress rather than big wins.

While the Moon in your sign today is strong for getting in touch with your feelings, dear Libra, needs, wants, and desires can be complicated. With current Mars challenges, dear Scorpio, sticking with what's familiar can be a compulsion, but it can prevent you from growing and thriving, so consider dividing your time. Pull yourself away from areas where you're feeling overly attached or stressed. Do your best to avoid obsessing over things that you have no power to change. Mars in your solar ninth house finds you seeking opportunities to grow, learn, connect, and improve, but you may need to get over an obstacle or disappointment before the wind returns to your sails. Consider that you may have been ignoring some of your fundamental needs, and this has been gradually wearing you down. Aim to address problems in due time, particularly if they're persistent.

Today's focus tends to be on your social needs, dear Sagittarius. Still, you may feel a little divided or out of sorts with Mars challenges. If you’re feeling particularly sensitive to imbalances, make it your priority to take things easy and aim to explore the areas where you might need some more discipline.

You can quite enjoy taking care of business today, dear Capricorn. Find ways to loosen up and relax so that you can enjoy the new energy and enthusiasm that's now building in your life. Something or someone may be draining you, and you need to take a step back to catch your breath or reimagine your plans. While there can be confusion and exaggeration to the day's energies, you are in a good position to turn it into a positive, even if it's only about slowing down and taking a break from overthinking.

While today's Moon helps you see the bigger picture, dear Aquarius, today holds some potential for awkward energy, requiring you to slow down or make adjustments. Most important for you is to manage stress by identifying what is making you feel off your game and taking steps to remedy the situation. Watch for the tendency to become moody if things aren't going exactly to script today, dear Pisces. It may be best to keep expectations in check. The day's energies are complicated but ultimately can get you closer to your heart. Watch for desires and whims that distract you from your goals, though, as these may be a form of procrastination.
